external.description: In this deep dive, we investigate HyperFrames—the open-source framework launched by HeyGen in October 2026 that treats web code as a video timeline. Instead of dragging clips across a traditional timeline or burning SaaS subscription credits, HyperFrames enables autonomous AI agents to construct, parameterize, and render deterministic MP4 video directly from HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. We break down how deterministic headless browser rendering works, how it contrasts with HeyGen’s credit-metered avatar ecosystem, and what code-driven video generation means for the future of media production.
